usage: agentbreeder mcp grant [-h] [--project DIR]
                              [--dry-run | --expect-base SHA256] [--json]
                              AGENT SERVER TOOL [TOOL ...]

Grant TOOLs of SERVER to AGENT in stack.yaml (shown as a diff). Only
environment.agents.AGENT.mcp changes; run `services up` to apply it to the
relay. Deploy uses only tools the agent requests in agent.yaml and the stack
grants.

positional arguments:
  AGENT                 an environment.agents name
  SERVER                an mcp: entry name
  TOOL                  tool name(s)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --project DIR
  --dry-run             Show the diff; write nothing
  --expect-base SHA256  Refuse unless stack.yaml is still this digest (from
                        --dry-run)
  --json
